newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila C. Bank big dollar seller after baht float.
newsitem.headline: Manila C. Bank big dollar seller after baht float.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank was selling dollars heavily on Wendesday at 26.377 pesos after the Bank of Thailand said it would allow a managed float of the baht, traders said.
Volume on the foreign exchange market had already reached a $146.7 million after the first 30 minutes of trade.
In recent months, the Philippine peso had been subject to repeated speculative attacks as a result of Thailand's financial woes.

Despite repeated denials by the Manila government that there is anything fundamentally wrong with their economy, analysts said investors are worried that the Philippines could follow Thailand, especially if an overextended property sector were to hit bank profits.
